exec: pm.test("Generated ID and JSON fields", () => { pm.expect(o.orchidId).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(o.orchidId).not.to.eql(999999); pm.expect(o.natural).to.eql(true); pm.expect(o.attractive).to.eql(true); pm.expect(o.orchidName).to.eql("Taichung Beauty"); });
